card1.answer: No, Mazeed will show the same shipping options activated on your store.
card1.question: Is Mazeed responsible for shipping and delivery?

card2.answer: No, Mazeed will show activated products using the same quantity and price as on your store.
card2.question: Is it necessary to specify a separate inventory for Mazeed?

card3.answer: All orders will be shown under the order page on the merchant dashboard with an indication of the order source, whether the order is from the store or Mazeed.
card3.question: Where will I receive orders coming from Mazeed?

card4.answer: No, there is no subscription fee. Mazeed will charge a percentage from sales on Mazeed, and the percentage is shown on the contract.
card4.question: Is there any subscription fee for listing my product on Mazeed?

card5.answer: Yes, the Mazeed platform will include marketing plans throughout the year for Mazeed and the products listed on it.
card5.question: Are there any marketing plans for the Mazeed platform?
